interaction-states.twistDescription: Easing swap on all button transitions from noir ease-in cubic-bezier(0.55,0,1,0.45) to decisive expo-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), durations held at 0.1s for a kinetic snap-out response.

type-system.twistDescription: Letter-spacing injection (0.08em) on the display/heading role for engineered, kinetic challenger tracking

motion-system.twistDescription: Faster duration scaling (motion-system B, x0.65): all transitions snap from 0.15s/0.3s to 0.098s/0.195s for kinetic, confident feel.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Section-specific breathing room — only elements.section padding boosted +48px (160->208 vertical, 40->88 horizontal) for bold, confident section framing; all other spacing untouched.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D — injected wide 0.1em letter-spacing on nav links for a bold, kinetic insurgent read

grid-system.twistDescription: Container max-width expand (immersive): container.maxWidth 1360px -> 1600px for a bolder, more immersive full-bleed B2B layout

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted the Content Sections paragraph into a more kinetic register (marquee tearing, hard-cuts, lurching scale).
